construction: Two tapered horns rise from one fixed base. A single rope wraps the waist and crosses between the horns, with one strand continuing outward. Follow the mounting surface and the existing rope direction in the artwork.
author: Jazzmanian
modifications: Cropped the completed hitch at right, rotated it and added a white margin.

construction: A rope turns through a rigid ring attached to a support. Trace the near and far arcs, the standing line and its short return.
author: PattayaPatrol
changes: Cropped around the working mooring eye, converted to grayscale, and reduced to 900 pixels.

construction: A single folded envelope has four exterior edges on one plane and one triangular flap contained inside that perimeter. Interpret both in the perspective of the envelope in the scene.
author: Ice-Dolphin
changes: Rasterized at 660 pixels on the long side and placed on a neutral gray surround.

construction: A thin cello bridge stands on two feet. Four distinct strings rest in shallow notches across its curved upper edge. Preserve its orientation relative to the strings and the front of the instrument.
author: Turidoth
changes: Cropped to the bridge and string path, converted to grayscale and resized to 840 pixels.

construction: The rounded crown flows into a heart-shaped facial disc with two dark eyes and a narrow beak between them. Follow the silhouette in the drawing’s own orientation.
author: Thomas G. Barnes / U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
license: Public domain in the United States, US federal government work
changes: Cropped around the head and shoulder, converted to grayscale and resized to 750 pixels.

construction: In a lateral view of a seated cat, one eye and the muzzle extend in profile, forepaws support the forequarters, and the haunch sits behind the forelegs. The curled tail rests on the same surface. Match the requested coat, direction, perspective and medium of the illustration.
author: Hortensja Bukietowa
changes: Cropped to the seated animal and its point of support, resized and JPEG-encoded.

construction: Three-quarter head rotation exposes the near cheek and eye and a narrower far cheek and eye. Orient the nose bridge and chin together. Use this sample only for relative positions. Orient to the requested direction and preserve the identity, expression, hair, outfit and drawn features of the source.
author: Google MediaPipe authors
changes: Locally rotated the canonical face surface, rendered a grayscale orthographic view and projected the eyelid landmarks. See mediapipe-license.txt.

construction: A slender swept crest emerges at the forehead, stands clear of the round head and tapers backward. The compact hooked beak and cheek patch sit below it. Color varies with the bird requested.
author: Oldcockatoo
modifications: Cropped one bird from the lower left, keeping the crest, face and upper body.

construction: A long white stand-off coat, pointed muzzle, small triangular ears and dark nose. Keep the pose, lighting and painted medium of the requested scene.
author: Canarian
modifications: Cropped to the head and neck. This crop is distributed under the same CC BY-SA 4.0 license.

construction: At each side of the shoe tongue a thumb opposes a curled finger around one lace. The two visible strands approach the same central crossing. Match the positions of the wrists and the boot in the original illustration.
author: Shixart1985
modifications: Cropped the wrists, fingers, laces and shoe from the original photograph.

construction: One slender solid bone strip with softly curved sides and rounded ends. It lies flat beneath the fingers and has only one thickness. Preserve the original hand and the pressure point.
author: Edinburgh City of Print

construction: Stacked glass prism courses follow the lantern optic around its vertical axis. Align the stepped glass faces with the supporting frame. Match illumination, engraving and perspective to the requested illustration.
author: Dave Krueger, U.S. National Park Service
license: Public domain in the United States, work of the U.S. federal government
modifications: Cropped the working lens from the view inside the Bodie Island lantern room.

construction: Look at the hand from the back. Four fingers arise separately along the knuckle arc, with their fingertips at different lengths. The thumb originates lower on the radial side of the palm. Turn or mirror this guide to match the actual wrist, handedness and camera angle. Keep contact with the depicted support and preserve the original character design and drawing medium.
author: Eyefive45

construction: One playback arm has a fixed pivot on the deck, a continuous arm and a small cartridge at its free end. The pivot is on the case floor, separate from the lid hinge. Swing its free end over the disc or onto its rest according to the requested action. Retain the drawing’s perspective and material.
